LAPTOP.definition: The laptop as a whole, covering general opinions on its overall quality, price, design, performance, portability, usability and how well it meets the user's needs.

DISPLAY.definition: The laptop's screen and its properties, such as resolution, brightness, colors, viewing angles, glare and size.

KEYBOARD.definition: The laptop's keyboard and its keys, including layout, feel, key travel and backlighting.

MOUSE.definition: The pointing devices of the laptop, mainly the touchpad/trackpad and its buttons, including any external mouse that comes with it.

MOTHERBOARD.definition: The laptop's motherboard (main board/logic board) and failures attributed to it.

CPU.definition: The laptop's processor, including its speed, model and processing power.

FANS_COOLING.definition: The laptop's fans and cooling system, including noise, heat dissipation and overheating.

PORTS.definition: The laptop's ports and connectors, such as USB, HDMI, Ethernet, card readers and headphone jacks, including their number and placement.

MEMORY.definition: The laptop's RAM, including its amount, speed and upgradability.

POWER_SUPPLY.definition: The laptop's power supply unit, i.e. the charger, AC adapter and power cord.

OPTICAL_DRIVES.definition: The laptop's optical drive (CD/DVD/Blu-ray drive) and its ability to read or burn discs.

BATTERY.definition: The laptop's battery, including battery life, charging time and battery durability.

GRAPHICS.definition: The laptop's graphics card/GPU and graphics performance, e.g. for gaming or video.

HARD_DISC.definition: The laptop's storage drive (HDD or SSD), including its capacity, speed and failures.

MULTIMEDIA_DEVICES.definition: The laptop's built-in multimedia devices such as speakers, microphone, webcam and audio/sound components.

HARDWARE.definition: The laptop's hardware in general or hardware components not covered by other entities (e.g. hinges, casing, wireless card, buttons).

SOFTWARE.definition: Software and applications on the laptop other than the operating system, including preinstalled programs, bloatware, drivers and productivity suites.

OS.definition: The laptop's operating system (e.g. Windows, Mac OS, Linux) and its usability, stability and features.

WARRANTY.definition: The warranty of the laptop, including its coverage, duration and extended warranty plans.

SHIPPING.definition: The shipping and delivery of the laptop, including delivery speed, packaging and condition on arrival.

SUPPORT.definition: The technical and customer support for the laptop, including service centers, phone support, repairs and staff helpfulness.

COMPANY.definition: The company or brand that manufactures the laptop and opinions about it in general.
